summary: UMH Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing equity distribution agreement, updating the list of distribution agents for its at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering. The registrant, acting as issuer, continues to have up to $150 million in aggregate sales price available under the program, with approximately $44.6 million remaining unsold. The amendment is a routine administrative update to the distribution agent lineup, not a new capital return event or special situation. There are no deal terms, no premium, no target, and no structural changes to the offering mechanics.
